summary: Keep Pi roster subagents unreported because the Pi channel does not forward subagent observations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Pi joins OpenCode and other non-observing drivers in omitting the optional roster subagents field. Only Claude, Codex, and OMP report an empty list when no subagents are running. The Pi channel currently ignores subagent frames; its shared channel implementation does not imply OMP's observation capability.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption beyond the normal daemon upgrade.

recovery.detail: Normal rollback is supported; an older daemon may again report a false empty subagent list for Pi.
